printf 'KEYSTORE_FILE_ENV=%s
' "$([ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE:-}" ] && echo present || echo absent)"; printf 'KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_ENV=%s

' "$([ -n "${LCL_ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD:-}" ] && echo present || echo absent)"

set -e; echo CANDIDATE_SIGNING_FILES; for d in "$HOME/.local-climate-link" "$HOME/.config/local-climate-link"; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then find "$d" -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sed "s#^$HOME#~#"; fi; done; echo PROFILE_REFERENCES; for f in "$HOME/.zshrc" "$HOME/.zprofile" "$HOME/.bash_profile" "$HOME/.bashrc"; do if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q 'LCL_ANDROID_' "$f"; then printf '%s: ' "$(basename "$f")"; grep -o 'LCL_ANDROID_[A-Z_]*' "$f" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; fi; done
set -e; echo EXISTING_RELEASE_DIRS; if [ -d artifacts/releases ]; then find artifacts/releases -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort; else echo none; fi

set +e; gh auth status --hostname github.com >/tmp/lcl-gh-auth.txt 2>&1; AUTH_RC=$?; sed -E 's/(token:).*/\1 [redacted]/I' /tmp/lcl-gh-auth.txt; echo GH_AUTH_RC=$AUTH_RC; gh api repos/MichalMatu/local-climate-link-starter/immutable-releases >/tmp/lcl-immutable.json 2>/tmp/lcl-immutable.err; IMM_RC=$?; if [ $IMM_RC -eq 0 ]; then python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/lcl-immutable.json")); print("IMMUTABLE_RELEASES_ENABLED="+str(bool(d.get("enabled"))).lower()); print("IMMUTABLE_ENFORCED_BY_OWNER="+str(bool(d.get("enforced_by_owner"))).lower())'; else echo IMMUTABLE_RELEASES_ENABLED=false_or_unavailable; sed -n '1,3p' /tmp/lcl-immutable.err; fi; gh release view v2.0.10 --repo MichalMatu/local-climate-link-starter >/dev/null 2>&1; echo V2010_RELEASE_EXISTS=$?; exit 0
